guide.summary: City Palace, two private museums and a temple, with breakfast spots, dinners, cocktail bars and a bakery, each checked against its own website.
guide.tip: City Palace is open seven days a week and closes only on Dhulandi, but the Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing and The Amber Terrace are closed on Mondays, so plan those for another day.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: City Palace is open seven days a week and closes only on Dhulandi, the second day of Holi. The Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing and The Amber Terrace at The Leela Palace Jaipur are closed on Mondays.

toolkit.label: City Palace tickets
toolkit.copy: City Palace sells tickets at both Gate 1 and Gate 2; an adult museum ticket is ₹400 and the ₹500 composite adds Jaigarh and the Royal Cenotaphs. The ₹4,000 Chandra Mahal Royal Tour is sold only at the counter.

toolkit.label: Dinner sittings
toolkit.copy: Jamavar at The Leela Palace Jaipur serves dinner in two sittings, 7–9 pm and 9–11 pm, and lunch on Friday to Sunday only. The Oberoi Rajvilas takes online reservation requests for up to 8 guests at Surya Mahal.

toolkit.label: Age rules
toolkit.copy: Jamavar does not accommodate children under 12 because it is entirely candlelit, and The Amber Terrace is an adults-only dining experience. At City Palace, children under 5 don't need a ticket.

guide.dek: Give City Palace any day but Dhulandi, keep Mondays clear of the Anokhi Museum and The Amber Terrace, and book hotel dining ahead.
intro: City Palace is the natural first stop. Its own site says the museum is open 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM, seven days a week, with last tickets at 6:00 PM, and that it closes only on Dhulandi, the second day of Holi. You can enter through Gate 1 near the Jantar Mantar ticket counter or Gate 2 at Jaleb Chowk, and an adult museum ticket is ₹400. The Textile Gallery in Mubarak Mahal has been temporarily closed for restoration since March 27, 2026, and the Museum at Night is also temporarily closed.

Out at Amber, the Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing occupies Anokhi Haveli near Keri Gate. It opens Tuesday to Saturday, 10:30am to 5pm, and Sunday, 11am to 4:30pm, and is closed on Mondays and on listed holidays such as Deepawali. Block carving and printing demonstrations run through the day apart from a lunch break, and the galleries close every year for maintenance from May 31 to July 15. Back in C Scheme, the Amrapali Museum on Ashok Marg publishes hours of Monday to Saturday, 11 am to 6 pm, and features an object of the month.

For dining in town, Niros on Mirza Ismail Road lists Continental, Tandoori, Mughlai and Chinese dishes, and Chokhi Dhani's village fair and restaurant sits on Tonk Road. At ITC Rajputana on Palace Road, Jaipur Pavilion serves all day from 11:00 to 23:00 and the Sheesh Mahal bar keeps the same hours. Further out at Kukas, Jamavar at The Leela Palace Jaipur serves dinner in two sittings, 7–9 pm and 9–11 pm, offers lunch Friday to Sunday only, and does not take children under 12.

For a slower morning, The Peacock Lounge at The Leela serves breakfast from 7:00 to 10:30 am, and Surya Mahal at The Oberoi Rajvilas on Goner Road opens at 7:00 am. In the evening, The Amber Terrace at The Leela opens 4:00 to 11:00 pm, is adults-only and is closed on Mondays, while Rajwada Library Bar at The Oberoi Rajvilas opens 5:00 to 11:00 pm. Closer to the centre, you'll find Theobroma's C Scheme branch at City Mall on Bhagwan Das Road.
summaryCards: Start at City Palace, open 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM and closed only on Dhulandi, entering by Gate 1 near the Jantar Mantar ticket counter or Gate 2 at Jaleb Chowk.
Take breakfast at The Peacock Lounge from 7:00 am, then visit the Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing in Amber on any day except Monday, when it is closed.
Check closing days: City Palace closes only on Dhulandi, while the Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing and The Amber Terrace are closed on Mondays.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Jaipur's state-run monuments (Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, Albert Hall Museum, Jantar Mantar, Nahargarh Fort) and Jawahar Kala Kendra could not be confirmed because their government websites failed DNS lookup or, for the obms-tourist.rajasthan.gov.in ticketing site, returned a certificate error; these failures are not evidence of closure. Taj (Rambagh Palace), Hilton and Jaipur Rugs returned HTTP 403, Blue Tokai and Bikanervala returned HTTP 429, and Bar Palladio, LMB, 1135 AD, Curious Life, The Johri, SUJAN Rajmahal and Raj Mandir could not be reached. Several confirmed places were published only partially: City Palace gives gate locations rather than a street address; Niros, Chokhi Dhani, Anokhi Café, Peshawri, Jal Mahal and the Fairmont Jaipur venues publish no exact hours; Anokhi Café's page gives the Anokhi Farm address; Theobroma (C Scheme) shows conflicting hours; ISKCON Jaipur's darshan times overlap on its page; Amrapali Museum's Sunday closure is inferred from Monday–Saturday hours. The Leela, Fairmont and Oberoi Rajvilas venues are outside the old city at Kukas and Goner Road. Only 22 places were confirmed, below the 25–35 target.
